notes: REARING. Intro: the bud rears back on its stalk (wind-up, held), strikes down at the foe and bobs back; the pad and the furled leaf hold. Two-hue case: the maroon (rim wall, stalk, bud, veins) is index 1 and the pad green index 2, the rim's lit lip white. Sport: 'Chromatella'. Nymphaea x marliacea 'Chromatella' (Latour-Marliac, 1887): canary-yellow flowers over bronze-mottled pads (indexes 1-2 only).
